suite.name: Northwind Baseline V1 Smoke
suite.description: 12-case environment and tool-chain smoke subset of Northwind Baseline V1.

cases.name: NW001 Customers in Argentina
cases.prompt: Northwind 中有多少客户位于 Argentina？只返回一列 customer_count。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE country = 'Argentina'

cases.name: NW022 Products in Beverages
cases.prompt: 统计 Beverages 分类中的产品数量。只返回 category_name 和 product_count，并保留该分类名称。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id)::int AS product_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Beverages' GROUP BY c.category_name

cases.name: NW033 Orders shipped to Argentina
cases.prompt: 统计运往 Argentina 的订单数量。只返回 ship_country 和 order_count。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ship_country, COUNT(*)::int AS order_count FROM orders WHERE ship_country = 'Argentina' GROUP BY ship_country

cases.name: NW055 Revenue for Condiments
cases.prompt: 计算 Condiments 分类的折后净销售额。净销售额定义为 unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount)。只返回 category_name 和四舍五入到两位小数的 net_revenue。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.category_name, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price::numeric * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount::numeric)), 2) AS net_revenue FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id JOIN order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Condiments' GROUP BY c.category_name

cases.name: NW065 Top products in Beverages
cases.prompt: 列出 Beverages 分类折后净销售额最高的 5 个产品。返回 product_name 和两位小数的 net_revenue，按 net_revenue 降序、product_name 升序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price::numeric * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount::numeric)), 2) AS net_revenue FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Beverages' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, p.product_name ASC LIMIT 5

cases.name: NW088 Supplier products in Netherlands
cases.prompt: 统计 Netherlands 供应商提供的产品数量。返回 supplier_country、supplier_count 和 product_count。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT s.country AS supplier_country, COUNT(DISTINCT s.supplier_id)::int AS supplier_count, COUNT(p.product_id)::int AS product_count FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN products p ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHERE s.country = 'Netherlands' GROUP BY s.country

cases.name: NW095 Monthly revenue in 1996
cases.prompt: 按月统计 1996 年折后净销售额。返回 month（YYYY-MM）和两位小数的 net_revenue，按 month 升序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price::numeric * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount::numeric)), 2) AS net_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month

cases.name: NW104 Shipping delay for Alliance Shippers
cases.prompt: 计算 Alliance Shippers 已发货订单从下单到发货的平均天数。只返回 shipper_name 和两位小数的 avg_ship_days。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT s.company_name AS shipper_name, ROUND(AVG(o.shipped_date - o.order_date)::numeric, 2) AS avg_ship_days FROM shippers s JOIN orders o ON o.ship_via = s.shipper_id WHERE s.company_name = 'Alliance Shippers' AND o.shipped_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.company_name

cases.name: NW115 Revenue for employee King
cases.prompt: 计算姓氏为 King 的员工负责订单的全部折后净销售额。返回 employee_name 和两位小数的 net_revenue。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee_name, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price::numeric * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount::numeric)), 2) AS net_revenue FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id WHERE e.last_name = 'King' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name

cases.name: NW120 Null customer region
cases.prompt: 检查 customers.region 的空值数量。只返回 field_name 和 null_count。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT 'region' AS field_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE region IS NULL)::int AS null_count FROM customers

cases.name: NW136 Category report for Beverages
cases.prompt: 分析 Beverages 分类的产品数量、当前库存数量和按当前单价计算的库存价值，并创建一份报告。报告必须包含文字结论。用于报告的最终查询只返回 category_name、product_count、units_in_stock 和两位小数的 inventory_value。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id)::int AS product_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.units_in_stock), 0)::int AS units_in_stock, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(p.unit_price::numeric * p.units_in_stock), 0), 2) AS inventory_value FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Beverages' GROUP BY c.category_name

cases.name: NW149 Customer value ranking
cases.prompt: 列出折后净销售额最高的 10 个客户，并同时给出最后下单日期和订单数。返回 company_name、last_order_date、order_count 和两位小数的 net_revenue，按 net_revenue 降序、company_name 升序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.company_name, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)::int AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price::numeric * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount::numeric)), 2) AS net_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, c.company_name ASC LIMIT 10
